limitations: Observational cohorts are not randomized or matched by opportunity.
Overlapping hypothetical trades are correlated; counts are not independent portfolio returns.
Missing legacy clock/risk parameters and right-censored outcomes are excluded.
No filter, risk, strategy, or execution changes are recommended automatically.

method.commission_model: not supplied; results do not establish executable net profitability
method.control_group: broker-confirmed filled directional candidates; requests and submitted/pending orders are excluded
method.entry_assumption: candidate signal bar maps to nearest retained M1 bar at or before event timestamp; hypothetical entry uses next bar open, matching backtest simulator
method.provenance: Only explicitly UTC-tagged candidates with recorded positive stop and target distances are eligible; legacy/incomplete evidence is excluded.
method.recorded_spread_sensitivity: uses the spread recorded at each decision plus configured hypothetical slippage; commissions and live execution are not established
method.safety: offline analysis only; execute_trades forced false; no strategy, risk, or execution policy changed
